about: acceptance fixture: co-extracted (retired claim, candidate) cases for the re-anchor probe and its second reading. Each case is one passage, the state claim an update retired, and the claims extracted beside it. 'expected' is DEPENDS when the claim, read as a statement about now, relied on the retired circumstance being current, else HOLDS. Who labelled the cases, and the owner's review of the live runs, are recorded in 'labelled_by' and 'owner_review'. Run with: uv run python scripts/reanchor_fixture.py
labelled_by: proposed by the implementing session. The owner confirmed every HOLDS / DEPENDS label of the first ten cases (delhi-flat to staying-here) on 2026-09-27; the eight cases from gp-surgery on were added the same day to reach the thirty-restatement bar and await the owner's confirmation.
owner_review: 2026-09-27, first live run (claude-sonnet-4-6 on extraction and verification): the 13 restatements written were all labelled faithful and needed by the owner. The car and phone candidates were proposed by the probe but rejected by the second reading, so they were not written and were not labelled. Third live run, after the second reading was calibrated, the probe was held to the past tense and both calls ran at temperature 0: the 15 restatements written (car and phone included) were all labelled faithful and needed by the owner.
